notes.title: Making Our First-Ever Quill Plushie - Pre-Orders Live Now!
notes.content:
📣 [i]Note: this is a repost of our Moss dev post![/i]

It’s a special time of year for us at Polyarc—the anniversary of Moss! This marks [b]7 years(?!?)[/b] since Quill’s journey began. Can you believe it’s been that long since we first set out on this adventure? Moss has always been about connection, and we're beyond grateful for the love and support that has kept the bond with Quill strong.

This year, we’re making a long-time dream come true… the first-ever official Quill plushie! 🐭💚 

For years, our community has asked for a way to bring Quill home, and honestly? SAME. But as a small studio, finding a way to make it happen was always a challenge—until now. Thanks to Makeship, we finally have a chance to turn this dream into reality.

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105540/9a9992b0d54d23daa653f77b3add8f35e9ca7e39.png[/img][/url]

[h1]🐤Pre-Order Now for Early Bird Perks[/h1]
The Quill plushie will only go into production if we reach our goal of at least 200 pledges during this limited 7-day campaign. A $2 refundable pledge secures your spot and helps us bring Quill to life! We also have some compelling perks for our early bird pre-orders. 

✅ [b]Exclusive Discord role[/b] – Behind-the-scenes access + vote on key design details
✅ [b]First 200 pre-orders [/b]get a digital code for the Moss Original Soundtrack! 

For more details, [url=https://www.polyarcgames.com/news/7-years-of-moss-makeship-quill-plushie-bring-quill-home]check out our blog post and FAQ [/url]explaining the Makeship plushie process. 

Become an early bird and pre-order now: 
[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie]https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie [/url]

You can  also help us make this dream a reality is by sharing this with your friends, family and VR spaces to let folks know it’s time to bring Quill home.

notes.title: Announcing the Polyarc Creator Program
notes.content:
Dearest Reader,

Over the last few months, we’ve been working on something special and we’re finally ready to share it with you: the Polyarc Creator Program. 🥳

Whether you’re a small creator just starting off in your journey or you’ve been creating awesome VR content for years, we’re excited to support you in your efforts to produce content around Polyarc Games titles!

Some of the benefits creators can look forward to:

[list]
[*] Game Keys. Whether you’re spinning up a giveaway for your dedicated community or you want to create some awesome new Moss content, we’re here to make your dreams come true.
[*] The Content Creator Asset Drive. Full of official Moss art, videos, and logos, these assets will make anything you do look polished.
[*] Social Media Support. Have a new piece of content you’re proud to show off? We want to celebrate your success by highlighting what you do best across our official Polyarc social media accounts!
[*] A Special Discord Role. The official Polyarc Discord is growing, and we want to share a special space inside of it just for you!
[*] Special Collaboration Opportunities. We’re always looking at new and exciting ways to bring the joy of Moss to a whole new generation of VR players and we’d love to work with you to make this happen!
[*] And More! We have big plans on the horizon and we’re always looking for ways to expand the program.
[/list]

We can’t wait to see what you create. [url=http://www.polyarcgames.com/creators]Find out more on our website[/url]!

notes.title: Moss II OST Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105540/b67f928d53882acd3291c38744b60083a936849b.png[/img]

[h3]We laughed. We fought. We ugly cried in our VR headsets.[/h3] 
And as we stood beside Quill once more and witnessed her heartbreak and heroism, we fell in love with our tiny companion all over again. 

With the second anniversary of the second installment in the Moss franchise, we find ourselves reflecting not only on the journey so far, but also on the near universal acclaim and heartfelt player reviews we’ve received since the launch of our little mouse sequel. It’s a humbling experience for us to see our games seated in the “Best of VR” and “Must Buy” lists alongside the most incredible experiences and innovations happening in the virtual reality space. 

And as we reflect on all of this, it really does feel like we managed to create something special, something much more than a simple mouse game. 

[previewyoutube=Ufp4-TrY_Rc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎵 Moss: Book II Original Soundtrack Now on Steam[/h3] 
And now, to echo the joy of our second anniversary, we're thrilled to unveil a treasure many of you have whispered wishes for – the digital release of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059670/Moss_Book_II?utm_source=web&utm_content=news]Moss: Book II Original Soundtrack on Steam[/url]! You can now pick up the sweet tunes from Moss: Book II bundled with the game, or as an add-on. The sequel soundtrack consists of 17 in-game tracks for more than 140 minutes of music. 

[url=https://materia.store/collections/moss][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43105540/2cdfe74447d8da8c4fbb085822c5e6f75e57c0df.png[/img][/url]

It’s been an absolute privilege to partner with two-time BAFTA award-winning composer Jason Graves to score Quill’s adventure with his elegant, heartfelt, and thematic style in both Moss and Moss: Book II. 
For soundtrack collectors and fans of physical versions, you can purchase the limited run of both the Moss and Moss: Book II soundtracks as a premium [url=https://materia.store/collections/moss]CD and vinyl album on Materia Collective[/url].

One final thing! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8LDnuV6YL4&list=PLmppNXiLRAZ8NPLxcGwgrz9qEpP3YVv46]We've created a video playlist of the entire Moss 2 soundtrack for some chill & cozy listening on YouTube.[/url] Happy listening! 

Music is the heart of Moss, amplifying moments of triumph, despair, and tenderness as you navigate through the world, from the whispering woods to the ancient halls of forgotten lands. We hope diving back into these enchanting melodies brings you joy, and reignites those magical moments shared with Quill. 

Cheers, 
Polyarc 🐭💚

notes.title: Платформеры Moss и Moss: Book 2 войдут в стартовую линейку PlayStation VR2
notes.content: Polyarc объявила о выходе Moss и Moss: Book 2 на PlayStation VR2. Обе игры войдут в стартовую линейку устройства, релиз которого намечен на 22 февраля 2023 года. Предварительные заказы открыты, подписчиков PlayStation Plus ждёт 10% скидка.
